routine.title: Less routine, more done
routine.text: Drafts, digging through material, searching and checking — Metobe takes the routine, you keep what matters.

stronger.title: A little stronger every day
stronger.text: Understand, write, check, decide — an assistant is by your side in any task.

secondMind.title: A second mind for your work
secondMind.text: Think out loud, ask, try things — Metobe helps turn a thought into a result.

moreInDay.title: Do more in the same day
moreInDay.text: Answers, ideas and drafts in minutes — so there is time left for the work only you can do.

team.title: Your team at its best
team.text: Everyone on the team gets a strong assistant — and the whole team moves faster.

sources.title: Sources
sources.meta: {sources, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} · {models, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} in chat

empty.title: Connect your first source
empty.text: A source gives access to models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Yandex AI Studio, AI Gateway or your own server such as Ollama. We check the key right away.

openai.title: OpenAI
openai.blurb: GPT models over the OpenAI API

anthropic.title: Anthropic
anthropic.blurb: Claude models over the Anthropic API

gateway.title: Vercel AI Gateway
gateway.blurb: One key — models from many providers

yandex.title: Yandex AI Studio
yandex.blurb: Alice AI, YandexGPT and open models

openai-compatible.title: OpenAI-compatible
openai-compatible.blurb: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio and other servers

connect.title: Connect a source
connect.description: We check the key right away. If the source can't be reached directly, we'll find a proxy.
connect.compatibleKey: Key, if the server needs one
connect.keyHint: The key is encrypted and never shown in full again.
connect.folderHint: The folder in the Yandex Cloud console, starts with b1g

steps.keyUnknown: Not checked — the source didn't answer

proxyFound.title: {title} doesn't answer directly, but works through «{proxy}»
proxyFound.text: Only {title} will go through the proxy; everything else stays direct.

blocked.title: {title} doesn't answer from this network
blocked.text: Looks like a geo-block or a filter. Enter a proxy — only {title} will go through it, everything else stays direct. Or connect a source reachable from here, such as AI Gateway.

declined.title: {title} can't be reached directly
declined.text: Add a proxy in «System → Proxies» or connect a source that answers directly, such as AI Gateway.

auth.title: {title} rejected the key
auth.text: Status {status}. Check that the key is copied in full, not revoked and has access to models.

notFound.title: No API at this address
notFound.text: Status 404. Check the address: it should lead to the model API and usually ends with /v1.

unreachable.title: {title} is not answering
unreachable.text: No answer in 15 seconds, or the connection dropped. Check the address and the route.

http.title: {title} answered with error {status}
http.text: Looks like a problem on the service's side. Try again later; if it keeps happening, check its status.

invalid.title: That's not a model API
invalid.text: The answer doesn't look like a list of models. Check the address — it usually ends with /v1.

proxyInvalid.title: That doesn't look like a proxy address

proxyUnreachable.title: {title} doesn't answer through this proxy either
proxyUnreachable.text: Check the proxy's address and port, or try another one.

detail.name: Source name

health.footnote: We check with a real request, not the key's format: green means the source answers.

broken.title: This source's models are hidden from chat

off.title: The source is off
off.text: Its models are hidden from chat. The key and settings are kept — turn it on when you need it.

detail.keyNow: Now {hint}. The old key keeps working until the new one passes the check.
detail.keyRejected: The key didn't work — the old one stays.
detail.configRejected: The source didn't answer with this value — kept the previous one.

route.label: Route
route.hint: Proxies are set up in «System → Proxies»
route.autoHint: by the domains marked on proxies
route.whyProxy: Always through this proxy, domains aside
route.whyDirect: Always direct, even if a proxy has the domain

models.title: Models
models.synced: List refreshed: {added, plural, =0 {nothing new} one {# new} other {# new}}
models.missing: The source no longer lists: {list}. They stay until you turn them off.
models.empty: No models yet — press «Refresh the list».

caps.unknown: not checked — we'll try and turn it off on error
caps.title: Capabilities
caps.hint: Set by hand and kept when the list is refreshed. «Unsure» — we'll try and turn it off on error.

pricing.title: Price of {model}
pricing.hint: As in the provider's price list: the price per the given number of tokens. Saved exactly as typed, no rounding.
pricing.fromSource: The source reports this price; refreshing the list updates it.

remove.title: Disconnect {title}
remove.hint: The key is deleted and the models leave the chat. Chat history stays.
remove.text: The key is deleted and {count, plural, one {# model leaves} other {# models leave}} the chat's model picker. Chat history with them stays. You can connect again at any time.

drawer.unitHint: The prices above are per this number of tokens, as in the provider's price list. Saved exactly as typed, no rounding.
drawer.backToSource: Back to what the source says
drawer.backOnSave: Saving brings back the source's values.

capHint.structured: Answers strictly by a JSON schema

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.text: Providers are who made the models. They appear on their own once you connect a source.

detail.name: Provider name
detail.summary: {on} of {total, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} in chat
detail.footnote: One model can come through several sources — for example, Claude with an Anthropic key and through AI Gateway. The switch turns it on in that source.
detail.unavailable: The source is off or not answering

empty.title: No proxies — everything goes direct
empty.text: A proxy helps when a provider can't be reached from your network. Only what you mark goes through it.

https.label: HTTPS
https.hint: The connection to the proxy itself is encrypted

socks5h.label: SOCKS5h
socks5h.hint: Names are resolved on the proxy — when DNS is blocked too

new.title: New proxy
new.text: An address like host:port, or the whole thing with a scheme and login — e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:1080. We check it right away.

detail.name: Proxy name

check.title: Last check
check.footnote: The request goes through the proxy to a service that returns the IP: that shows where the traffic really exits.

detail.addressInvalid: An address like host:port — for example, proxy.corp.local:3128
detail.loginHint: If the proxy asks for a login and password
detail.enabledHint: A proxy that is off is not used: sources on it go direct
detail.throughMeta: {on} of {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}
detail.domainsHint: Everything on «Auto» going to these addresses goes through this proxy. A domain covers its subdomains.

remove.title: Delete «{title}»
remove.withSources: {names} will go direct — check they can be reached from this network.
remove.confirmWith: Going through it: {names}. They will go direct and may stop answering.

detail.domainInvalid: A domain like openai.com — no scheme, path or port

logoPicker.title: Logo
logoPicker.uploadHint: Or paste from the clipboard, or drop a file here
logoPicker.tooBig: The file is over 256 KB — a logo needs far less.

onboarding.settings: You can change all of this later in settings

pick.title: Where should models come from?

pick.moreText: In chat, models from all sources share one list.

key.text: {blurb}. We'll check the key right away.

models.enable: Turn on {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}

done.text: {names} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} waiting for the first question. Everything else is in settings, when you need it.
done.more: {count, plural, one {# more model} other {# more models}}
